tests.name: ordered_json_flatten_basic
tests.intent: Verify that flattening an ordered_json object preserves expected structure and key types.

tests.name: ordered_json_flatten_unflatten_roundtrip
tests.intent: Verify that flattening and then unflattening an ordered_json returns an identical object.

tests.name: standard_json_flatten_compatibility
tests.intent: Verify that standard nlohmann::json flatten gives identical results to ordered_json flatten.

tests.name: ordered_json_flatten_empty_containers
tests.intent: Verify flattening of empty arrays and empty objects within ordered_json maps to null values.

tests.name: ordered_json_flatten_primitive_root
tests.intent: Verify flattening an ordered_json whose root itself is a primitive value.

tests.name: ordered_json_flatten_null_root
tests.intent: Verify flattening an ordered_json whose root is null.

tests.name: ordered_json_flatten_array_root
tests.intent: Verify flattening an ordered_json whose root is a populated array.

tests.name: ordered_json_flatten_deeply_nested
tests.intent: Verify flattening an ordered_json with deep nesting structures.

tests.name: ordered_json_flatten_escaped_keys
tests.intent: Verify flattening handles JSON pointer key escaping (~ and /) correctly in ordered_json.

tests.name: ordered_json_flatten_order_preservation
tests.intent: Verify that flatten preserves key iteration order for ordered_json outputs.

tests.name: json_pointer_lexical_comparison_check
tests.intent: Exercise json_pointer comparison operators used in code paths adjacent to flatten.

tests.name: json_pointer_stream_insertion
tests.intent: Exercise streaming json_pointer objects to std::ostream.

tests.name: json_pointer_concatenation_operators
tests.intent: Exercise operator/ concatenation on json_pointer objects.

tests.name: ordered_map_direct_emplace_new_key
tests.intent: Exercise the new emplace_new_key method directly on nlohmann::ordered_map.

tests.name: ordered_json_flatten_large_number_of_leaves
tests.intent: Verify linear flatten performance correctness with a moderately large tree of leaves.

tests.name: ordered_json_unflatten_invalid_pointer
tests.intent: Verify exception handling when unflattening malformed flat keys.

tests.name: json_pointer_string_comparisons
tests.intent: Verify json_pointer comparison against raw string literals.

tests.name: ordered_json_flatten_mixed_types
tests.intent: Verify flattening an ordered_json containing booleans, floats, strings, and integers together.

tests.name: ordered_json_flatten_nested_arrays
tests.intent: Verify flattening ordered_json containing arrays inside arrays and objects inside arrays.

tests.name: ordered_json_flatten_empty_object
tests.intent: Verify flattening an entirely empty ordered_json object.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Invoke flatten() on nlohmann::ordered_json to explicitly instantiate and execute add_flattened with priority_tag<1> and obj.emplace_new_key.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Directly call emplace_new_key on an nlohmann::ordered_map instance with a constructible value type to execute the SFINAE enabled function template.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Perform flatten() on a nested ordered_json object containing multiple types, verifying that every leaf insertion utilizes emplace_new_key via priority_tag<1>.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercise emplace_new_key on ordered_map with string values requiring move construction to verify correct forwarding and construction trait SFINAE evaluation.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Flatten an ordered_json containing mixed arrays and empty objects, ensuring that all code paths routing through add_flattened with priority_tag<1> successfully execute.

tests.name: gen_22_fixed
tests.intent: Directly call emplace_new_key on an nlohmann::ordered_map instance with a constructible value type to execute the SFINAE enabled function template.

tests.name: gen_24_fixed
tests.intent: Exercise emplace_new_key on ordered_map with string values requiring move construction to verify correct forwarding and construction trait SFINAE evaluation.
